# Link Graph Round Trip — write with wikilinks → links/backlinks/orphans round-trip

-- source-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Source Note
summary: Note that links to other pages
tags: linkgraph
---
This note references [[target-note]] and [[decisions/graph-decision]].
It also has a broken link to [[missing-page]].
-- source-input.md --

-- target-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Target Note
summary: Note that is linked to
tags: linkgraph
---
This is the target note. It links back to [[source-note]].
-- target-input.md --

-- adr-input.md --
---
type: adr
title: Graph Decision
status: proposed
deciders: team
summary: Decision for link graph testing
tags: linkgraph
created: '2026-01-01'
updated: '2026-01-01'
---
We decided based on [[source-note]] and [[target-note]].
-- adr-input.md --

-- orphan-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Orphan Note
summary: Note with no inbound links
tags: linkgraph
---
This note stands alone with no links to or from other pages.
-- orphan-input.md --

# --- Setup: initialize KB and write pages ---

exec akb init test-kb
cd test-kb

exec akb write source-note.md <../source-input.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/source-note.md'

exec akb write target-note.md <../target-input.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/target-note.md'

exec akb write graph-decision.md <../adr-input.md
stdout 'Written to kb/decisions/graph-decision.md'

exec akb write orphan-note.md <../orphan-input.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/orphan-note.md'

# --- links show: outbound links from source ---

exec akb links notes/source-note.md
stdout 'Outbound:'
stdout 'target-note'
stdout 'graph-decision'
stdout 'Broken:'
stdout 'missing-page'

# --- backlinks: pages linking to target ---

exec akb backlinks notes/target-note.md
stdout 'notes/source-note.md'
stdout 'decisions/graph-decision.md'

# --- backlinks: pages linking to source ---

exec akb backlinks notes/source-note.md
stdout 'notes/target-note.md'
stdout 'decisions/graph-decision.md'

# --- orphans: pages with zero inbound links ---

exec akb orphans
stdout 'notes/orphan-note.md'

# --- Delete source note, verify link graph updates ---

exec akb delete notes/source-note.md
stdout 'Deleted kb/notes/source-note.md'

# Source note no longer appears in backlinks of target
exec akb backlinks notes/target-note.md
! stdout 'notes/source-note.md'
stdout 'decisions/graph-decision.md'

# Orphan list updates (target now has fewer inbound links)
exec akb orphans
stdout 'notes/orphan-note.md'

# --- Delete target note, verify link graph updates ---

exec akb delete notes/target-note.md
stdout 'Deleted kb/notes/target-note.md'

# Decision's outbound links no longer resolve target
exec akb links decisions/graph-decision.md
stdout 'Outbound:'
stdout 'Broken:'

# --- Delete decision, verify orphans update ---

exec akb delete decisions/graph-decision.md
stdout 'Deleted kb/decisions/graph-decision.md'

# Only orphan note remains
exec akb orphans
stdout 'notes/orphan-note.md'

# --- Delete orphan note, empty link graph ---

exec akb delete notes/orphan-note.md
stdout 'Deleted kb/notes/orphan-note.md'

exec akb orphans
! stdout .

# --- Core I/O still works after link graph operations ---

exec akb status
stdout 'Pages: 0'
